name: Crazy Quilt
description: Crazy quilt blocks: every square cut once on a random slant into two fabrics, the seam embroidered with a gold fly stitch and the edges with running stitch.

code.style: --rule: ( background: @var(--edges); @random(${shapeFrequency}) { --a: @r(6, 94); --b: @r(6, 94); background: @var(--edges), @p(var(--color2), var(--color3), var(--color4), var(--color5), var(--color6)); -webkit-transform: rotate(@p(0deg, 90deg, 180deg, 270deg)) scale(1.012); transform: rotate(@p(0deg, 90deg, 180deg, 270deg)) scale(1.012); :before { content: ''; position: absolute; inset: 0; background: @var(--edges), @p(var(--color2), var(--color3), var(--color4), var(--color5), var(--color6)); -webkit-clip-path: polygon($(a)% 0%, 100% 0%, 100% 100%, $(b)% 100%); clip-path: polygon($(a)% 0%, 100% 0%, 100% 100%, $(b)% 100%); -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; } :after { content: ''; position: absolute; left: $((a + b) / 2)%; top: 50%; width: $(sqrt(10000 + (b - a) * (b - a)))%; height: 12%; background: @var(--fly); -webkit-transform: translate(-50%, -50%) rotate($(atan2(100, b - a) * 57.29578)deg); transform: translate(-50%, -50%) rotate($(atan2(100, b - a) * 57.29578)deg); -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; } } -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; );
code.doodle: :doodle { @grid: ${grid}; @size: ${width} ${height}; overflow:hidden; text-align:center; box-sizing:border-box; --edges: repeating-linear-gradient(90deg, var(--color1) 0 6%, transparent 6% 12%) 0 2% / 100% 3% no-repeat, repeating-linear-gradient(180deg, var(--color1) 0 6%, transparent 6% 12%) 2% 0 / 3% 100% no-repeat; --fly: linear-gradient(var(--color1), var(--color1)) 0 50% / 100% 22% no-repeat, repeating-linear-gradient(90deg, var(--color1) 0 3%, transparent 3% 12%) 0 0 / 100% 50% no-repeat, repeating-linear-gradient(90deg, transparent 0 6%, var(--color1) 6% 9%, transparent 9% 12%) 0 100% / 100% 50% no-repeat; } :container { background: var(--color0); overflow:hidden; }
